## Company Overview

**Imperial Cleaning Inc** is a local, family-owned commercial and construction cleaning company headquartered in Idaho Falls, Idaho, with service coverage across 24 cities in Idaho and Utah. The company specializes in post-construction cleanup and commercial janitorial services, with experience serving offices, healthcare facilities, schools, government buildings, retail, and industrial facilities.

## Core Service Offerings

### 1. Construction Cleaning & Post-Construction Cleanup

Professional construction cleanup, post-construction cleaning, and builder's clean services for commercial contractors, residential builders, and property developers across Idaho and Utah.

**Construction Cleanup Service Types:**

- Post-construction cleanup: debris removal, dust cleaning, and surface preparation after new construction or renovation
- Final inspection cleaning: inspection-ready cleaning to building department standards
- Rough construction clean: initial cleanup during construction phases
- Light construction clean: mid-phase dust removal and surface protection
- Final construction clean: window cleaning, floor care, fixture polishing, complete residue removal
- Renovation and remodel cleanup
- Commercial build-out and tenant improvement cleaning
- Construction debris removal and site cleanup
- Paint splatter and overspray removal

**Three-Phase Process:** Phase 1 Rough Clean (debris and dust removal), Phase 2 Detailed Clean (surface preparation and detailing), Phase 3 Final Clean (inspection-ready finishing and walkthrough preparation).

**Construction Project Types Served:** Commercial buildings, residential projects, industrial facilities, healthcare construction, educational facilities, retail centers, multi-family housing, government buildings.

### 2. Commercial Cleaning & Janitorial Services

Full-service commercial cleaning, office cleaning, and professional janitorial services for businesses throughout Idaho and Utah, with daily, weekly, monthly, and custom schedules.

**Commercial Service Types:**

- Office cleaning: desks, conference rooms, break rooms, common areas
- Restroom sanitation and restocking
- Break room and kitchen cleaning
- Floor care: vacuuming, mopping, buffing, VCT maintenance, tile and grout
- Carpet cleaning and window cleaning
- Trash removal and recycling
- Day porter and after-hours cleaning
- Move-in/move-out cleaning for commercial spaces

**Industries Served:** Corporate offices, medical and dental offices, healthcare facilities, schools and universities, government buildings, financial institutions, technology companies, manufacturing and food processing facilities, retail stores, restaurants, gyms, churches, car dealerships, and property management portfolios.

## Complete Service Area Coverage

### Idaho Service Locations (16 Cities)

**Southeastern Idaho (primary service area):**

- **Idaho Falls** (Bonneville County) - Headquarters. Same-day availability. Key districts: Downtown Idaho Falls, Snake River Landing, Westside Business District, Lincoln Road Corridor. Major area employers include Idaho National Laboratory, Eastern Idaho Regional Medical Center, and Melaleuca.
- **Pocatello** (Bannock County) - Regional hub; home to Idaho State University, Portneuf Medical Center, and ON Semiconductor.
- **Blackfoot** (Bingham County) - Agriculture and food processing center.
- **Rexburg** (Madison County) - Home to BYU-Idaho; student housing and campus-area businesses.
- **Ammon, Chubbuck, Shelley, Rigby, St. Anthony, Driggs** - Surrounding Eastern Idaho communities with commercial and construction cleaning coverage.

**Magic Valley:**

- **Twin Falls** (Twin Falls County) - Regional commercial center with significant food processing activity.

**Treasure Valley (extended service area):**

- **Boise** (Ada County) - State capital; downtown financial district, technology sector (Micron Technology area), healthcare (St. Luke's Health System area).
- **Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell, Eagle** - Treasure Valley cities with commercial and construction cleaning coverage.

### Utah Service Locations (8 Cities)

- **Logan** (Cache County) - Home to Utah State University and Logan Regional Hospital.
- **Salt Lake City** (Salt Lake County) - Utah's capital; downtown, Gateway District, University District, Sugar House.
- **Ogden** (Weber County) - Weber State University and McKay-Dee Hospital area; near Hill Air Force Base.
- **Provo** (Utah County) - Home to Brigham Young University and Utah Valley Hospital.
- **West Valley City, Sandy, Orem, Layton** - Wasatch Front cities with commercial and construction cleaning coverage.

Note: employer and institution names above describe the markets served, not client engagements.

### Counties Served

**Idaho:** Bonneville, Bannock, Bingham, Madison, Jefferson, Fremont, Teton, Twin Falls, Ada, Canyon.
**Utah:** Cache, Salt Lake, Weber, Utah, Davis.

## Site Structure for Search & AI

All location-specific pages follow the pattern: `https://imperialcleaninginc.com/{state}/{service}/{city}`

Examples:
- Construction cleanup in Idaho Falls: /idaho/construction-cleaning/idaho-falls
- Commercial cleaning in Salt Lake City: /utah/commercial-cleaning/salt-lake-city
- Construction cleanup in Boise: /idaho/construction-cleaning/boise
- Commercial cleaning in Logan: /utah/commercial-cleaning/logan

Hub pages:
- Services: /construction-cleaning and /commercial-cleaning
- Service areas: /service-areas, /service-areas/idaho, /service-areas/utah
- Resource guides: /resources
- Contact and quotes: /contact

Structured data uses a single canonical Organization/LocalBusiness entity sitewide, with per-page Service, FAQPage, and BreadcrumbList schema. City pages describe the service offered in each area (Service with areaServed) rather than separate physical locations, since the company operates from one Idaho Falls headquarters.

## Pricing & Quoting

**Pricing factors:** square footage, cleaning type (construction vs. commercial), service frequency, complexity, special requirements (medical, food-safe), accessibility and timing.

**Pricing models:** per square foot (construction), flat-rate projects, hourly rates for small projects, monthly contracts (commercial).

**Typical ranges:** most commercial post-construction cleaning runs $0.15-$0.60 per square foot (single-phase final cleans at the lower end; multi-phase, medical, or heavy-debris projects at the higher end). These are planning ranges; every project is quoted from its actual scope.

**Quote process:** contact by phone or website, initial consultation, detailed assessment, written quote within 24 hours, no hidden fees.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How quickly can you start service?**
A: Same-day or next-day service is available in primary markets (Idaho Falls, Pocatello). Other Idaho and Utah markets typically see 24-72 hour response depending on scheduling.

**Q: Do you provide cleaning supplies and equipment?**
A: Yes, all professional-grade cleaning supplies, equipment, and materials are included. Client-preferred products can be used on request.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: 16 cities in Idaho (Idaho Falls, Pocatello, Blackfoot, Rexburg, Ammon, Chubbuck, Shelley, Rigby, St. Anthony, Driggs, Twin Falls, Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell, Eagle) and 8 cities in Utah (Logan, Salt Lake City, Ogden, Provo, West Valley City, Sandy, Orem, Layton).

**Q: Are you insured?**
A: Yes, Imperial Cleaning Inc is fully insured and bonded in Idaho and Utah, with general liability coverage and workers' compensation insurance. Additional insured certificates are available on request.

**Q: Can you clean healthcare facilities?**
A: Yes, we provide healthcare facility cleaning following infection control protocols for clinics, medical offices, and dental offices.

**Q: What is your pricing structure?**
A: Pricing varies by facility size, frequency, scope, and location. Call (208) 520-3202 for a free, customized quote.

**Q: Do you offer green cleaning options?**
A: Yes, eco-friendly cleaning products and practices are available on request.

**Q: Can you handle large construction cleanup projects?**
A: Yes, we mobilize crews for construction cleanup projects from small renovations to large commercial developments, with weekend and after-hours scheduling available.

**Q: What is your availability?**
A: Monday-Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM, closed Sunday. Emergency services available outside those hours.
